steps.en: Offender mobile numbers are obtained from the data source
steps.id: Nomor mobile offender diambil dari sumber data
steps.why_en: The pull from the data source is switched off in every environment, so only the number already stored is used.
steps.why_id: Pengambilan dari sumber data dimatikan di semua environment, jadi hanya nomor yang sudah tersimpan yang dipakai.

steps.en: Unique individual offenders are identified and their notices merged into one SMS
steps.id: Offender individu yang unik diidentifikasi dan notice-nya digabung dalam satu SMS
steps.why_en: Notices with different due dates for the same offender still produce separate SMSes.
steps.why_id: Notice dengan tanggal jatuh tempo berbeda untuk offender yang sama tetap menghasilkan SMS terpisah.

steps.en: The SMS lists outstanding notices and refers to the 3rd letter
steps.id: SMS memuat notice yang masih outstanding dan merujuk ke surat ke-3
steps.why_en: Message wording is stored outside the code, and a missing template can still be logged as sent.
steps.why_id: Redaksi pesan disimpan di luar code, dan template yang hilang tetap bisa tercatat sebagai terkirim.

steps.en: The reminder SMS is sent to the offender by the batch job
steps.id: SMS reminder dikirim ke offender oleh batch job
steps.why_en: Both the daily job and SMS sending are switched off in production settings, so nothing is sent as configured.
steps.why_id: Job harian dan pengiriman SMS sama-sama dimatikan di setelan produksi, jadi sesuai konfigurasi tidak ada yang terkirim.
